params.body:
Second of three. Activiteit stops being its own page and becomes a tab in Inzichten.

The split I invented a day earlier — Inzichten is the business, Werking is the machine, Activiteit is the traffic — sounded tidy and produced a second place to look at numbers, which is the opposite of taking work off somebody's hands. It also let me build a second analytics screen next to one that was already better structured.

## The tab is named, not numbered

`?tab=activiteit`, the way the settings do it (R P2-10.16). A name survives a reordering and can be sent to somebody; `?tab=2` means nothing and breaks the day a tab is inserted. An unknown name opens the first tab rather than erroring.

The old `/activity` keeps working and redirects: it is in the menu, in bookmarks, and in my own messages from yesterday.

## What moved

`index.blade.php` is now a shell of 55 lines: the heading, the tab strip, and an include. The body it used to hold is `insights/_zaak.blade.php`, unchanged, and `insights/_activiteit.blade.php` is three lines that render the Livewire component that already existed.

The chart script is only loaded on the tab that uses it. Sending 27 kB to a tab that never touches it is wasted traffic.

## What deliberately did not happen

The existing charts stay Bootstrap. Converting them to Tailwind is a third project and would make this step unreviewable; the two tabs will briefly wear different clothes. That is ugly and honest, and it keeps the conversion a separate, bounded job instead of something that rides along.

## Verified

`ActivityScreenTest` now opens the tab, and a new case pins that the old address redirects to it. Two other suites followed the move: the event-log test and the page-view test, the latter now counting `insights.index` where it counted `activity.index`.

New rule R P3-16.10. `npm run build` green, `npm run lint -- --max-warnings=31` green at exactly 31, `phpstan` green, `pint` green on the added files. The existing `InsightsController` fails `pint` as it did before this change — CI checks added files only, and 864 files in this repository disagree with it.

Local suite: the same nine failures as on a clean `main` in my environment (two known `ListPageHeadersTest`, six `IntegrationSmokeTest` reading an `OUTBOUND_IMPACT` from my local `.env`, one warranty test). CI runs on a fresh database.

## Third step

Rebuild what the Activiteit tab shows. It borrowed its layout from Werking, which is a status screen — a stack of sections each with one number — and that is why it reads flat. Real analytics is one measure at a time sliced many ways, with the comparison as the main thing rather than a grey footnote, and drill-down on every number. The measuring layer underneath it (`Activity`, `ActivityEvents`, `PageViews`) stays as it is.
params.title: Activity as a tab in Insights
